statement: Pinned public host implementations provide distinct direct hidraw/feature-report and kernel-derived evdev consumer paths for DualShock 4. A virtual DualShock 4 UHID node's host driver/SDL backend must be observed rather than assumed from VID/PID or mapping database.

applicability.revision: source revisions pinned in part 1 and G, host versions not measured
applicability.scope: Consumer-routing documentation only: SDL PS4 HIDAPI reads calibration features 0x02 (USB)/0x05 (BT), input 0x01/0x11 and writes lightbar/FF; modern kernel optional firmware 0xA3; historical hid-sony required it. Wine supports BT hidraw fixing. No actual Steam, SDL, browser, Wine, InputPlumber or emulator host test was run. Additional independent source pin: Chromium Gamepad Linux udev input/hidraw enumeration; WebHID has both static and dynamic protection rules. InputPlumber source matching is version-scoped and does not assert a local host pass.
